lawyer:
Abdul Jabbar, Advocate instructed by Mohammad Nawab Ali, Advocate-on-Record ------ For the Petitioner.

parties:
Ayub Ali ------ Petitioner.
Vs.
Ali Akbor @ Khoda Boksha & others ------ Respondents.
full_judgment: 6. It is clear, the trial Court and the appellate Court concurrently held that the plaintiff has right, title, interest and possession in the suit land. The High Court Division also concurred with the concurrent findings of facts arrived at by the Courts below. The learned Advocate for the petitioner could not point out any misreading and non-consideration of materials on record by the appeal Court which is the final Court of fact and also by the High Court Division. It further appears that at the time of hearing before the High Court Division the present petitioner filed a patta before the High Court Division for the first time but the patta was with him since 1941 but did not file the same before any Court. Accordingly, the High Court Division refused to accept the same and in our view rightly.
